name: @playform/ets-hook-dsh-test-suggester
description: The test-suggester hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that answers the test task intent with a target set. When the model searches for proof (a grep for PASS/FAIL/error TS, a read of a Test.ts, a bash error sweep), the hook classifies the call deterministically and names the likely targets BEFORE the model finishes searching: the suite's Test.ts assertion body, the suite README carrying the expected count, the aggregate runner (Maintain/Run-Smokes.mjs), and the README badge that must agree with the count. Deterministic classifier, no LLM in the hot path; high threshold, at most maxCandidates candidates, a stated reason per candidate, a cooldown, and an abstention path - a wrong target set costs more than a missing one. Plan: Documentation/Plans/SEARCH-SUGGESTER-PLUGIN.md (sections 3, 4, 8).
